title: Drones struck a data center owned by Russia's Yandex in the town of Sasovo, marking the first major attack on a Russian data hub since the Ukraine war began (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Drones struck a data center owned by Russia's Yandex in the town of Sasovo, marking the first major attack on a Russian data hub since the Ukraine war began — Drones hit a data centre owned by Russia's Yandex , the country's leading AI and technology company said on Thursday …
